company.name: Finaloop
company.shortDescription: Finaloop offers real-time ecommerce accounting software and bookkeeping services for DTC, multichannel & wholesale.
company.description:
Finaloop is the financial operating system built for DTC, ecommerce, and retail brands. We replace your accounting software and service, inventory management system, and profit analytics tool - giving you full visibility across your business in one unified solution.
Get fully reconciled, GAAP-ready financials and real-time insights to make smarter, faster decisions and drive profitable growth - without the complexity or cost of an ERP.
From startups to large enterprise, Finaloop helps you scale while staying lean by automating 90% of your financial and operational workflows.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based ecommerce accounting platform combined with expert bookkeeping services providing real-time, accurate financial statements and bookkeeping for DTC, multichannel, and wholesale sellers.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $35,000,000, or 67.31% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $12,464,328 to $210,630,691, a 16.9x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 70 (+2 over 90 days) and market heat at 53 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
